aspects.says: In a container the JVM sizes its heap from the memory limit, and MaxRAMPercentage sets the share when -Xmx is not given.
G1 is the balanced default, Parallel favours throughput, and ZGC or Shenandoah keep pauses short on large heaps.
aspects.reason: which collector fits depends on measured pause times and throughput, which a unit test cannot produce; the GC algorithms have their own page in module 40

aspects.says: GC logging through -Xlog:gc* and heap dumps on OutOfMemoryError should be on in production.
aspects.reason: configuration of a JVM launch, which a practice test cannot set for its own JVM

aspects.says: jmap -histo:live and a plain jcmd GC.class_histogram force a full GC, so production histograms use the variants that skip it.
basis: section:Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them

aspects.says: Java 21 adds opt-in generational ZGC, JFR events for virtual threads and container awareness by default.
Java Flight Recorder records low-overhead events in production, and custom events extend jdk.jfr.Event.
aspects.reason: a recording needs the JVM's recorder and a dump to read back, and what it captures depends on timing

aspects.says: A leak shows as heap used after full GC growing over time, is confirmed with a heap dump, and usually comes from unbounded caches, lingering listeners or ThreadLocals.
aspects.reason: the fixes are practised elsewhere: a bounded LRU cache on the data structures page (39-data-structures) and the leak patterns in the memory management module (40)

aspects.says: -Xmx, -Xms and -Xss size the heap and thread stacks, in sizes with k, m or g suffixes, and -Xms may not exceed -Xmx.
MemoryMXBean and MemoryPoolMXBean report used, committed and max for each area, and max is -1 when a pool has no limit.
Start from the defaults, set only the collector, heap size and pause goal, and measure before adding flags.
aspects.reason: a judgement about a production system, not a behaviour a test can check

aspects.says: A container is OOMKilled when the whole JVM, heap plus Metaspace, stacks, code cache and direct memory, exceeds its limit, so the limit must leave room above -Xmx.
